roleContext.roleTitle: Procurement Lead, Indirect and Packaging Spend
roleContext.jobDescription: A chilled-food manufacturer with two plants buys packaging consumables, facilities services and engineering spares from around 300 suppliers. The procurement lead runs tenders under the procurement policy, keeps supplier master data and onboarding checks in order, reports renewals and spend to budget holders and works through purchase-order exceptions with accounts payable. Next year the company plans to consolidate its packaging supply base and wants a lead who has already led a supplier-consolidation programme, owning the sourcing strategy and the award decisions. The procurement lead reports to the head of procurement and works with the plant managers and finance.

requirements.text: Runs competitive tenders for indirect categories under the procurement policy.
Maintains supplier master data and completes onboarding checks.
Has led a supplier-consolidation programme, owning the sourcing strategy and the award decisions.
Reports contract renewals and spend to budget holders.
Resolves purchase-order exceptions with accounts payable.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Procurement Lead, Indirect and Packaging Spend

## Experience

- Recognition: in the 2023 procurement awards write-up at Tolland Foods, the chief procurement officer is quoted calling the candidate 'the driving force behind our supplier consolidation' who 'single-handedly reshaped the packaging supply base'.
- Procurement specialist at Tolland Foods from 2020 to 2024; on the packaging-consumables consolidation, issued the request for quotation to 14 suppliers, built the price and lead-time comparison and drafted the award paper that the category manager took to the sourcing board.
- Ran three tenders for facilities services (cleaning, waste collection and pest control) under the company procurement policy, each scored by a two-person evaluation panel.
- Kept supplier master data in SAP Ariba and completed onboarding checks: insurance certificates, food-contact declarations and call-back verification of bank details.
- Produced the quarterly contract-renewal and spend report for budget holders, flagging contracts within 90 days of expiry, and cleared the monthly purchase-order exception list with accounts payable.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the anonymised price and lead-time comparison workbook from the packaging-consumables tender, with its scoring tabs and the draft award paper, whose approval block names the category manager and the sourcing board.
